stories.title: Three North East ISD elementary schools face closure as board prepares to vote
stories.summary: The district says consolidating the campuses could save $4 million annually, but families want leaders to explore every option before deciding.

stories.title: Dale’s wait is over! Shepherd mix adopted after more than 450 days | Forgotten Friends
stories.summary: The playful 5-year-old found a home over the weekend after a lengthy wait through Texas Round Up Animal Alliance.

stories.title: San Antonio lands $9.1 million grant for greenway expansion with pedestrian bridge
stories.summary: The Beitel Creek project will connect the Wurzbach Parkway Trailhead to Weidner Road, with construction expected to begin in summer 2027.

stories.title: CLEAR Alert issued for missing 20-year-old last seen in Alamo Ranch area
stories.summary: Robert Segura Jr. was last seen Thursday evening driving a black pickup, according to the alert. Anyone who sees him should call 911.

stories.title: Person dies after being struck by train near I-35 on San Antonio’s northeast side
stories.summary: Police said the person had not been positively identified. The train’s conductor remained at the scene and cooperated with investigators.

stories.title: 'I hope her story can save someone' | Friends remember Texas mother killed aboard cruise ship
stories.summary: Friends remember Susan Watford, a Texas mother of three killed aboard a cruise ship, and hope her story raises awareness about domestic violence.

stories.title: San Antonio man accused of beating dog with belt, kicking it on balcony
stories.summary: Animal Care Services took custody of the dog, which had eye and head injuries consistent with blunt force trauma, according to police.

stories.title: CALL KENS: LeafFilter immediately resolves contract issue for northside SA woman
stories.summary: LeafFilter charged Sharon Kamm for a gutter protection system but initially didn't install it. The company fixed it after Kamm called KENS 5.

stories.title: Veterans benefits bills await Senate action after clearing House
stories.summary: The proposals would expand veterans’ services, allowing eligible combat-injured retirees to receive full military retirement pay alongside VA disability compensation

stories.title: Pregnant Texas woman vanished in 2016. Three people now face capital murder charges
stories.summary: Sheryia Grant disappeared from Kilgore in August 2016, just weeks before her daughter was due. Three people have since been charged with capital murder.

stories.title: Man faces animal cruelty charges after two dogs found dead in downtown San Antonio car
stories.summary: Robert Ramirez was supposed to care for the dogs after their owner’s arrest, according to arrest documents. His bonds total $30,000.

stories.title: Silver and Black bring holiday magic with meals, Christmas trees and gifts for San Antonio families
stories.summary: The Spurs’ annual Season of Giving brings players, staff and community partners together to spread cheer through Thanksgiving and Christmas.
